$schema_note: THE LAWS REGISTRY (W1.4, Sep 22 2026). Machine-readable source of truth; docs/laws-registry.md is rendered from it; scripts/smoke-laws.ts is the meta-gate. Tier 1 = the 14 invariants of docs/stabilization-plan.md PART II (outcome or walk gate required); tier 2 = domain laws (a pure-function test required, named in `fn`); tier 3 = lessons (compact `lessons[]`, no gate obligation) and obsolete laws. Gate kinds: source (asserts source text) · pure (calls a pure function) · outcome (census on DB/probe data) · walk (browser journey). Gate cost: zero-ai · cached · live-ai. Status: holding · broken-live (a Sep 22 audit finding names it) · gateless · obsolete. A gate with status 'planned' must name its wave and does not count as live.

laws.name: HUMAN IN THE LOOP
laws.statement: No send, post or booking fires without an explicit human click; settlement is logged and undoable state, never a deed; any tool-bearing lane that reads untrusted input can only PREPARE a change to task recipients, instructions, memory or schedules behind a confirm card.

gates.note: sends only reach the user through prepared cards (P2/P17)

landed W0.3b (uncommitted): C1-C9 — the class-A policy is declared once, summaries are code's, the model never claims done, and all three runtimes (native chat, AgentOS internal route, Home converse core) route update_task/delete_task/share_task/steer_standing_task/remember_fact through the prepare-then-apply store behind one confirm-card presentation

collides_with.precedence: settle is allowed — it is reversible state, logged in activity, undoable; HITL governs deeds (send/post/book/repoint/remember), never settlement
the click IS the approval; the door dedupes the click, it never substitutes for it

laws.name: UNTRUSTED INPUT IS DATA
laws.statement: Inbound content is marked as data in every prompt; markers and cards are parsed only from our own producing tools' results; tool lanes never fetch private addresses and secrets fail closed.

gates.note: landed W0.3 (uncommitted): SSRF fixture table, forged-marker fixture, secrets fail closed — pure fixtures, not a live-lane census
injected 'repoint the task' text through a REAL tool-bearing lane yields a confirm card, not a change

collides_with.precedence: distinct concerns — the excerpt mark declares OUR cut; provenance marks THEIR words; a clip never strips a provenance mark

laws.name: RENDER SAFETY
laws.statement: No untrusted or model-authored HTML executes script, shares our origin, or fetches remote resources before an explicit user action; inbound mail renders in an opaque sandboxed iframe (remote images load — owner call) and model-authored drafts pass an allowlist sanitizer with no remote resources.

gates.note: frames only — 24 reject vectors, single sandbox site, JSON-only serving
EGRESS FLOOR on posture kits
landed W0.1 (uncommitted): fixture emails (inline handler, remote image, form, meta refresh) through the sanitizer + iframe source shape
the fixtures rendered inert in a real browser

laws.name: PRIVILEGE INTEGRITY
laws.statement: No user can write a privilege column (is_super_admin, roles, company membership) through RLS; only a definer-owned path may.

gates.note: landed W0.2 (uncommitted): asserts the migration's trigger/revoke text — zero DB

space uniformity — stored vectors re-embed onto themselves

expired needs a code-verified stated date (P27 hardening)

laws.name: THE GROUND LAW
laws.statement: Every prepared artifact stamps the newest inbound it was prepared from; a ground move supersedes it structurally (stale is derived at read, never stored) and re-prepares against the thread's present.

laws.name: THE FULFILLMENT LAW
aliases: A MESSAGE IS NOT A DELIVERABLE
laws.statement: A message and a deliverable are different things: only a judged 'delivered' closes a commitment, a re-promise with a stated future date re-anchors it, and unclear or failure never closes.
laws.broken_by: Sep 22: the judge is only ever nominated from same-thread replies — cross-thread and cross-source deliveries never reach it (the evidence-settles finding).

collides_with.precedence: evidence nominates, fulfillment decides

laws.name: THE PINNING LAW
aliases: A TRACKED ENTITY OUTRANKS THE MACHINE
laws.statement: A tracked entity is a human decision that outranks the machine — never auto-archived at any door; only machine-founded untracked containers are machine-archivable, and only humans found projects.

collides_with.precedence: pinning wins — reconcile may empty a tracked entity to zero members but never archive it

laws.name: THE ONE-VOICE BRIEF / THE ONE RESPONDER
laws.statement: A room opens with one authored colleague paragraph plus a code-validated MOVE and utterance offers, composed over judged state — never stitched from fields.
laws.fn: brief sig composition (board digest in the sig)
laws.broken_by: Sep 22: the composed brief never reaches first paint — the after() compose lands after the stitched fallback has painted, and the fallback is exactly the field-assembly the law forbids.

collides_with.precedence: compose before paint; else append, never swap

laws.name: THE MOVE YIELDS
laws.statement: The room's MOVE yields to any rendered decision or artifact card — one CTA row, and a click on it is the deed, never an echo.
laws.broken_by: Sep 22: the render plan yields to decision cards but not to draft cards — a drafted reply and the MOVE compete on the same row.

collides_with.precedence: LAW 7 (one CTA row) governs the SURFACE; the trichotomy governs the ENGINE — every judged-actionable lands somewhere, and the surface then shows exactly one door to it

laws.name: THE NARRATION FOLLOWS ITS ARTIFACT
laws.statement: A prep narration folds into its artifact card by dedupe key and survives only while the current verdict's lane holds that artifact — an orphaned narration never stands alone.
laws.fn: one prep-key builder shared by writer and anchors

laws.name: THE ONE-NARRATOR LAW
laws.statement: Narration is the chief-of-staff voice with author absent; a coworker's face and name appear only on their own first-person speech; user, coworker and event lines derive structurally.

laws.name: THE PRESENTATION LAW
laws.statement: Every object has one card and one renderer; reads hand back cards and speech is composed around them, never the reverse.

gates.note: landed W3.6 (uncommitted): DC1-DC4 — the handed-commitment deck row now mounts THE ONE OBJECT CARD with its founding context (source kind, the thread's inbox item or meeting, the newest message line, the judge's reason, the project, the live prepared kind), one receipt, and a who-derived avatar, via one batched read

collides_with.precedence: a card that is never mounted is no card; the invariant outranks the kit's claim

laws.name: THE TRICHOTOMY
laws.statement: Every judged-actionable item lands PREPARED, ASKED or PARKED — never nowhere, never a silent none.
laws.fn: pass lane dispatch (verdict → lane) as a pure table
laws.broken_by: Sep 22: the commitment lane prepares artifacts no surface renders (landed nowhere in effect); the outcome feed biases the judge toward none, so actionables are demoted out of the trichotomy.

laws.name: ONE CLAIM PER ROW
aliases: THE WORD FOLDS INTO THE SECOND LINE
laws.statement: A deck row makes one claim: ask-bearing states null the prepared chip and CTA, silent states render nothing, and every surface speaks the machine's one word.

collides_with.precedence: floor → ladder pick → single claim
the ladder decides which claim; this law nulls the others

laws.name: THE OPEN ASK OUTRANKS A STAGED SEND
laws.statement: In the machine ladder an open ask outranks a staged send, an unfireable send is not send-shaped, >48h judgments with nothing landed read unjudged, and superseded work reads preparing.

collides_with.precedence: the ladder only ranks claims that render

laws.name: THE MACHINE
laws.statement: The work-item lifecycle is derived at read time from existing truth through one pure ladder shared by the single and batch readers — never a stored state.

collides_with.precedence: the machine IS the one reader for item state; forking poolRowsToArtifacts breaks the invariant

laws.name: THE REACH LAW (LAW 1)
aliases: THE JUDGE IS THE ONLY GATE
laws.statement: No lane speaks outside the judge and no item stays beyond the judge's reach — reach is measured and reported.

gates.note: green with no threshold

landed W3.3 (uncommitted): F1 judgment-sweep/draft-sweep are dispatchers firing one bounded, claimed /api/internal/sweeps/user job per account (maxDuration 300) instead of a serial 300s loop, with an honest dispatched/dispatchFailed/usersLeftBehind report and the old serial loop kept as a logged fallback; F2 the prep_outcome ledger read is PAGED (the old .limit(1000) silent cap is gone); --census adds a read-only commitment-backlog view

laws.name: THE EXPIRY LAW (LAW 2)
aliases: A LAPSED OBLIGATION GETS A VERDICT, NOT A NAG
laws.statement: A lapsed obligation receives a verdict (expired · answered · still owed), never a repeated nag, and anticipation never fires on the long-overdue.
laws.broken_by: Sep 22: anticipation fires on long-overdue items with no bound and records no outcome.

collides_with.precedence: expiry is the domain form of time truth for obligations

laws.name: THE SERVED-WORDS LAW (LAW 3)
aliases: THE DECK NEVER SPEAKS A FROZEN SNAPSHOT
laws.statement: The deck's words are derived at serve time from current truth, never read back from a frozen snapshot.

laws.name: THE ECHO FLOOR (LAW 5)
aliases: THE USER'S OWN OUTBOUND IS NOT WORK
laws.statement: The user's own outbound coming back — and a campaign's echo — is never work; the floor sits at lane entry, before any door.

laws.name: THE DECK TRUTH GATE (LAW 6)
laws.statement: The deck is censused on real data with a threshold on every release — the census is permanent and is the template for every outcome gate.

laws.name: THE OUTCOME LOOP (LAW 7)
laws.statement: Accepted, edited and discarded verdicts are logged at every door and feed the judge and the drafters as balanced facts — a one-sided ledger feeds nothing.

gates.note: landed W0.6 (uncommitted): OUTCOME_FACTS_ENABLED defaults off; judge/drafter prompts carry no outcome facts; sig unaffected

landed W3.2 (uncommitted): L1-L5 — every strip door captures its outcome before the write that deletes the drafts, the row carries the full fate ladder (accepted/edited/discarded/done_elsewhere/expired/superseded), done_elsewhere counts as a verdict and is never phrased against preparing, the readiness report requires balanced classes + a min-N floor, and OUTCOME_FACTS_ENABLED is still OFF by default pending the owner's readiness read

collides_with.precedence: the trichotomy wins; outcome facts are quarantined until W3.2

laws.name: THE SEAT LAW
aliases: A CC SEAT IS NEVER THE USER'S DEBT
THE TRUST LAW (direct recipient never hidden)
laws.statement: A request addressed to a CC seat is never the user's debt, and a direct-recipient reply owed is never silently hidden — the seat in the thread decides the posture.

laws.name: THE SELF-RECOGNITION FLOOR
aliases: OUR OWN COWORKER MAIL IS A POINTER
laws.statement: Mail from the user's own coworker addresses is a pointer to work, never work itself, and never third-party noise.

laws.name: THE NOISE FLOOR
laws.statement: Noise is never prepared, never founds an entity, and a brief never obliges the misaddressed.

laws.name: THE STAGING LAW
laws.statement: Only the item's own pool material or a same-entity file auto-stages; evidence is quoted and code-checked; a global hit becomes a named suggestion in the ask, never a staged attachment.

laws.name: THE ASK-DIRECTION FLOOR
aliases: OUR ASK IS NEVER THE COUNTERPARTY'S DEBT
laws.statement: Our ask to the user is never the counterparty's debt; the engine ask accepts a typed value or a go-ahead through one door and re-runs the engine.

laws.name: THE ALREADY-BOOKED FLOOR
laws.statement: An invite whose attendee already has a calendar event within ±12h prepares nothing and strips the unsent duplicate; a stated day without a time earns a proposed time inside every stated constraint.

laws.name: THE DEIXIS LAW
aliases: NO DECAYING DAY-WORDS IN STORED TEXT
laws.statement: Stored text never carries decaying day-words — extraction resolves them absolute against the source's own date, and state prose bans them.

laws.name: THE WATERMARK LAW
laws.statement: Every judge sees where the thread stands NOW — the sender's own words with quotes stripped — and an unverifiable count is passed unknown, never a confident zero.

laws.name: FAILURE HONESTY
aliases: A FAILURE IS NEVER A VERDICT
laws.statement: An AI outage is marked and never cached, never resolves, strips or prepares; an empty completion retries once then throws; a null result is spoken, never silent.

laws.name: THE HONESTY FLOOR AT THE ANSWER DOOR
aliases: NO DENIAL WITHOUT A REGISTRY CHECK
laws.statement: No denial leaves the agent loop without a registry check, and the registry pointer fires only when the denial sentence itself names a registry entity.

laws.name: THE VERDICT MOVES THE POSTURE
laws.statement: A dispositioned none resolves the item (undoable, logged, narrated) and artifacts contradicting the verdict strip with their narrations — through one consequence module.

collides_with.precedence: a verdict-driven resolve is settlement: logged, undoable, never a deed

laws.name: CORRECTIONS STICK
laws.statement: A human correction (refusal, dismissal, membership move, re-answer) sticks — the machine re-reasons around it and never silently reverses it.

collides_with.precedence: a re-answer is a new deed with a new key — idempotency never swallows a correction

laws.name: THE DENSITY LAW
laws.statement: A calm Home is a greeting, at most five rows and one composer — density is earned by the day, never padded.

laws.name: THE ATTENTION QUALITY LAWS (Q1–Q8)
laws.statement: The triage deck bands by consequence under a budget, graduates only on a why-now, never restates the settled, and keeps a held-quiet ledger the user can open.

laws.name: THE DEED FLOOR
aliases: ONE PREDICATE FOR EVERY FINAL SAY
laws.statement: One predicate decides whether a lane's final say is a deed; a send in chat needs the user's own explicit words, never a model mapping.

laws.name: THE ROW TAG + THE ROOM-DOOR LAW
laws.statement: Every deck row derives its project tag from the entity link against the tracked registry on the served payload, and a project-member row opens its project room.

laws.name: THE STAMPED CACHE
laws.statement: A local cache is stamped and an action surface never paints from one too old to trust; only a valid response replaces state (last-good), and a stale 'running' row never paints.

collides_with.precedence: a warm cache is the first paint; the background refresh appends or lands on next open

laws.name: THE WORK-ITEM SPINE
aliases: AN UNDATED ITEM CAN NEVER BE OVERDUE
AN AUTOMATED NOTICE CAN NEVER BE OVERDUE
THE DONE SIDE NEVER EVICTS THE LIVE SIDE (SP1–SP5)
laws.statement: The read-time spine maps commitments, actionable items and deliverables to one shape: an undated or automated item is never overdue, and the done side never evicts the live side.

laws.name: THE NOTICE LAW
laws.statement: An automated sender never earns a reply or a chase, but a notice the user owes (payment failed, security, deadline) falls through to an action, never to silent awareness.

laws.name: PRECEDENCE CHAIN, NEVER AN AND
aliases: UNDERSTANDING IS QA BENEATH THE RULES
laws.statement: Two classifiers reaching one decision join by a precedence chain (user rule → understanding → fallback), never by an AND that disables the refiner exactly when it is needed.

laws.name: LABEL TRUTH
laws.statement: A mailbox label pair is KIND × POSTURE; a fallback kind is a placeholder never stamped final; applying a kind strips every other kind; and 'nothing to apply' is never recorded as success.

laws.name: SYNC SINGLE-FLIGHT
laws.statement: Every sync entry point funnels through one atomic per-connection claim; a stale claim self-releases and a losing push never advances the cursor.

laws.name: THE SYNC CORRECTNESS INVARIANTS
aliases: NEVER ADVANCE A DELIVERY CURSOR BEFORE ITS WORK IS COMMITTED
ONLY A FULL-WINDOW SYNC ADVANCES last_sync
A STORED EMAIL ALWAYS YIELDS ITS INBOX ITEM
laws.statement: Mail sync is at-least-once: cursors advance only after durable storage, only full-window syncs move last_sync, dedup is per user, pulls look back the whole window, and a stored email always yields or reactivates its inbox item.

laws.name: THREAD REPLY STATE IS STRUCTURAL
laws.statement: Whether the user replied is derived from direction and time on the actual thread — language-proof, re-derived at read — never from keywords or a one-shot event.

laws.name: THE HEADER FLOOR
aliases: NOTHING USER-SUPPLIED REACHES AN RFC822 HEADER UNSANITIZED
laws.statement: Nothing user- or model-supplied reaches an RFC822 header unsanitized, on either provider.

laws.name: THE PARITY LAW
laws.statement: Every UI verb is sayable and every primitive ships through all four doors (describe · coworker chat · Home chat · canvas) with one shared implementation, or it does not ship.
laws.broken_by: Sep 22: the input-supply form and the sayable supply diverged — the form rejected runs the chat tool resumed (repair in flight W0.4, uncommitted).

laws.name: THE FORWARD-MOTION LAW
laws.statement: An affirmation or a menu click executes the standing contract (EN/PT/ES/DE/FR, one corrective retry) — it never re-asks, and a settled engine ask archives whole.

gates.note: one known live flake (T2)

laws.name: THE OFFER LAW
aliases: OFFERABLE ACTIONS DERIVE FROM POST-FILTER TOOLDEFS
laws.statement: Offers and chips are derived from the scope's post-filter tool definitions — a chip claims only what the lane can deliver.

laws.name: THE FRESH FLOOR
laws.statement: Landing on bare Home is fresh — no implicit rehydration of an unseen old room; past conversations live behind explicit doors.

collides_with.precedence: ADDRESS wins — fresh governs the bare address only; an addressed thread is never rewritten to /home

laws.name: THE USER-VOICE LAW
aliases: RECENTS LIST ONLY REAL USER MESSAGES
laws.statement: A conversation is listed only when it holds a real user message and only live turns count — system use never parades as conversation.

laws.name: THE CONTAINERS LAW
aliases: DM = ONE THREAD · ROOM = RECORD · CHIEF CHAT = SESSIONS
laws.statement: A coworker DM is one continuous thread, a room is one continuous record, chief chat is sessions, and a run has exactly one creator-keyed room.

laws.name: THE VERB-SCOPE LAW
aliases: VERBS RENDER ONLY WITH THEIR OBJECT
laws.statement: A verb renders only attached to its object — a meeting action item structurally cannot show Reply; the rail carries no verb chrome.

laws.name: ONE NAVIGATION / ONE STAGE AT A TIME
laws.statement: In-room links route through the room's opener, a stage is summoned by the user and never auto-raised, and opening one stage lowers the others.

laws.name: THE ONE GROUNDING
laws.statement: Everything the brain knows about one room sits on one page consumed by every responder, so an answer structurally cannot disagree with the panel.
laws.broken_by: Sep 22: the room grounding never reads the deliverable pool (its 'prepared' is one of three definitions) and Home-ask builds its own world block outside the judge.

collides_with.precedence: the grounding consumes the one reader; it never re-derives

laws.name: ASK SUPERSESSION
aliases: ASKS LIVE AND DIE WITH THEIR WORK (SPEC LAW 3)
laws.statement: An ask is settled at every resolution door (checklist strips, text stays), one artifact carries one merged ask, a coworker's ask supersedes the engine's both ways, and an ask never blocks work-with-what-you-have.

laws.name: THE PERSON-BRIDGE LAW
aliases: AN INTERNAL COLLEAGUE IS NEVER A BRIDGE
A 1:1 SYNC IS A CHANNEL, NOT A PROJECT
laws.statement: An internal or same-domain person never bridges an item to an entity; people-first recall weights distinctive people by rarity, and a recurring sync is a channel, not a project.

laws.name: THE DISTINCTIVE-TOKEN LAW
laws.statement: Name matching uses distinctive, word-bounded tokens from the user's own words only — a generic token never binds an item, a workflow or a filing to an entity; ambiguity resolves to none.

laws.name: RECOGNITION IS IDENTITY-FIRST, PROVENANCE-FIRST
aliases: A DERIVED ITEM INHERITS ITS PARENT'S ENTITY
laws.statement: A derived item inherits its parent's entity structurally, recall is people-first with topic only a tiebreaker, and a named subject vetoes a people-match into founding the named work.

collides_with.precedence: the veto is the token law applied to the entity's identity, never its summary

laws.name: MEMBERSHIP RECONCILE
aliases: A MEETING MOVE CASCADES ITS COMMITMENTS
laws.statement: Any membership change re-reasons both source and destination entities and cascades a meeting's move to its own commitments; a manual move can never split a meeting from its action items.

collides_with.precedence: pinning wins

laws.name: THE LAW-6 LEDGER GRAMMAR
laws.statement: Entity state speaks one claim about what is owed, settled lines speak history never open-debt grammar, and the narration speaks deltas, never events.
laws.fn: ledger line renderer (settled vs open grammar)

laws.name: KIT-SIDE RENDER DISCIPLINE (threads clause 5)
aliases: HIERARCHY BY SPACING, NEVER PER-PARAGRAPH COLOR
laws.statement: One type scale per bubble; hierarchy by spacing and weight, never per-paragraph colour; every seat of the opening contract renders from the kit.
laws.broken_by: Sep 22: pinned lines render in a second colour tone.

laws.name: THE OVERLAY LAW
aliases: ANCHORED PANELS ESCAPE THEIR CLIPPING ANCESTORS
laws.statement: An anchored panel portals out of its clipping ancestors through one primitive, and every 'Add to project' door speaks one picker grammar.

laws.name: ONE DEED, ONE DOOR
laws.statement: Every approve, reject and supply on a parked run goes through the one resume door, which claims the park conditionally so a run is resumed exactly once.

gates.note: green while the claim was unconditional — matched the comment, not the predicate
landed W0.4 (uncommitted)

collides_with.precedence: the door is the domain instance of the invariant

laws.name: THE INPUT STATION + THE SUPPLY
aliases: A SUPPLY IS AN ANSWER, NOT AN ARRIVAL
laws.statement: A parked run takes paste, pin, attach or a spoken supply as the station's own output through one implementation; a supply resolves the run and never fires the door seam.

gates.note: landed W0.4 (uncommitted): a supply with approve:false resolves, never rejects

laws.name: THE COMMIT DOOR
aliases: SEND RIDES THE ONE COMMIT DOOR
laws.statement: A deed claims its key, fires, then records; a failure releases the claim and a duplicate key returns the prior result — the key includes everything that makes the deed a different deed.

collides_with.precedence: the key carries the answer; a re-answer is a new deed
the event door was over-applied — its key must include response+start

laws.name: THE STALE CLAIM
laws.statement: A commit-door claim with no recorded result older than the longest send budget is a crashed attempt, not an in-flight one — it is released and retried once (conditional on result IS NULL, so a racer that recorded meanwhile keeps its row); held forever it would wedge the idempotency key for good.
laws.note: landed W0.4 (uncommitted) alongside the door's other repairs; no suite exercises the crashed-attempt branch directly (a real timing fixture would need a manipulable clock) — gateless pending a fixture

collides_with.precedence: the door owns the claim; the stale-claim rule is its one escape hatch from a wedged key
a released-and-retried stale claim is still exactly one eventual fire; it never doubles a completed send

laws.name: THE CONFIRM POLICY
laws.statement: The class-A (prepare, never apply) / class-B (safe to apply) split for every tool reachable from a tool-bearing lane is declared exactly once in lib/work/confirm-policy.ts; a tool absent from the table is class A by default (fail closed); the three runtimes (native worker chat, the Home converse core, the AgentOS internal route) ask confirmClassOf(tool, args) rather than keeping a private list, and the change summary is composed by code from the tool's own arguments — never by the model.

gates.note: landed W0.3b (uncommitted): C1 the class-A set is declared once and unknown tools fail closed; C2 summaries are code's, no AI client reachable from any confirm-card module; C3 the tool result forbids 'done'; C4-C6 all three runtimes route class-A tools through the prepare path; C7 the store claims before it executes; C8 the doors are session-authenticated, id-only; C9 one host, the kit's approval kind

collides_with.precedence: the policy is the domain table; the invariant is the obligation every tool-bearing lane must satisfy against it

laws.name: THE EVENT DEED DOOR
laws.statement: An event-card answer fires once per (event, response, start) through the door; the note is delivered or not offered; recurrence targets the occurrence; reschedule preserves attendees and shape.

gates.note: does not exercise re-answer
landed W0.4 (uncommitted): accept→decline→accept produces three deed keys

laws.fn: event deed key (event id + response + start)

collides_with.precedence: the door is right; the key was wrong

laws.name: THE ONE PRODUCTION DOOR
aliases: ADDING A CAPABILITY = ONE EDIT AT THE DOOR
A FRAME IS AN ARTIFACT KIND, NOT A SURFACE
laws.statement: Every document or frame any actor ships materializes through one module carrying the tier ladder and the deterministic floors — one edit at the door upgrades every actor.

collides_with.precedence: replace-in-place only as the user's own action; engine regeneration versions

laws.name: THE CONTENT FLOOR
aliases: THE AUTHOR'S TEXT IS THE DOCUMENT'S TEXT
THE GATE IS NEVER THE DELIVERABLE
laws.statement: The author's text is the document's text — codegen formats and never authors; a thin or marker-shaped source refuses in code before any model runs; a gate output is never a deliverable candidate.
laws.fn: isThinFrameSource · deliverable picker by step TYPE

laws.name: THE FACTS FLOOR + THE DATA-BY-CODE LANE
laws.statement: Tabular material gets computed facts by code at the door (row-count and partition verified, still-wrong → null), and the '✓ computed in code' chip renders only from the structural provenance stamp.

laws.name: THE ARITHMETIC FLOOR
laws.statement: Computable claims are recomputed by code from quoted operands that exist in the source; an invented operand drops the check and a failed check is a revise, never a verdict.

laws.name: THE RENDER-VERIFICATION GATE
aliases: THE TEMPLATE TIER IS THE FLOOR
laws.statement: A compiled document must render (page count printed by the sandbox) and pass magic-byte validation, with one stderr-carrying repair, or it yields to the template tier.

laws.name: THE FRAME SERIES — NEVER A TWIN
aliases: A SHARE IS A VIEW OF THE PRESENT
laws.statement: A workflow's frame has one head id updated in place with versions behind it; the public share is structurally query-blind and revoke is an instant, indistinguishable 404.

laws.name: FRAMES TELL THE TRUTH AND FIT
laws.statement: A truncated frame generation is detected structurally and retried compacted, every failure exit logs its cause, and frame chrome carries only dates present in the material or the code-provided today.

collides_with.precedence: the chrome rule is time truth applied to decorative text

laws.name: THE VERIFY GATE (the structured verdict)
aliases: THE BRIEF · YOUR RULES · THE STEP'S OWN ASK
laws.statement: The verify step returns the corrected draft plus a structured verdict whose block is honoured only with a rule finding and forced by a block-demanding rule; degradation is a deterministic floor, never a fabricated pass; the sentinel never leaks.

laws.name: THE PINNED STATION
laws.statement: The verify gate is seated by code on every steps mutation, auto-seats when an external-material or send step is added, and the inline insert is hidden where the seat would teleport it.

laws.name: THE STANDING BINDING
aliases: A SCHEDULED WORKFLOW HOLDS ONE OPEN COMMITMENT
laws.statement: A scheduled workflow holds exactly one open commitment advanced only by a successful run; the judge returns structural none for it; a human dismissal sticks; a spoken standing task prepares a code-validated spec that commits only on one explicit confirm.

laws.name: MANY DOORS, ONE RUN
laws.statement: A workflow's triggers are an any-of list read through one normalizer; authoring resolves by name with ambiguity refused; no editor may silently overwrite a trigger.

laws.name: DOORS ARE STRUCTURAL-BROAD + FILTERS FAIL CLOSED
laws.statement: A door's when names the kind of thing that arrives, never fit-for-a-role; deterministic filters gate candidacy before the judge and fail closed; material rides the fired run only, never the judge; a workflow never fires itself.

laws.name: THE THROTTLE, NEVER A SHREDDER
laws.statement: A per-workflow daily fire limit queues, never drops; deferred fires drain oldest-first under one atomic start claim shared by kick, backstop and drain.

gates.note: rare timing flake in the drain section

laws.name: A SUBPROCESS IS A HANDOFF TO A MACHINE
laws.statement: A subprocess parks the parent through the existing awaiting machinery with an insert-first claim, resumes atomically, propagates failure spoken, and refuses depth beyond one or a cycle.

laws.name: A CASE IS AN ENTITY
aliases: A FILED FILE IS A VISIBLE FILE
laws.statement: A case is a machine-founded untracked entity resolved by one stated key or one classification bound to the user's instruction; the run reads its case's accumulated page and a recorded conclusion is restated as settled unless the new arrival changes it.

collides_with.precedence: a case is untracked by construction — the machine may archive it

laws.name: THE RUBRIC RIDES VERBATIM BY CODE
laws.statement: A pasted rubric is placed verbatim by code where the model marks the slot; placeholder stripping is span-scoped and the original survives whole if less than 60% would.

laws.name: THE PLACED-GATES LAW
aliases: CODE SEATS WHAT THE MODEL UNDER-EMITS
laws.statement: The one-gate cap applies to gates the model invents, never to gates the user placed in their own text; missing placed gates are seated by code, counted by occurrence never by line.

laws.name: THE HANDOFF LAWS
laws.statement: The owner is the accountability layer while execution identity stays the creator; only the owner or the assignee may resume (a stranger is indistinguishable from not-found); name resolution refuses ambiguity; a coworker-less workflow speaks as the owner's assistant, never generic.

laws.name: THE RUN RECORD NEVER FABRICATES
aliases: A TEST AUTO-PASS IS NOT A HUMAN DECISION
laws.statement: A run's decisions and drift chips are derived only from recorded facts — never a borrowed SLA, never 'You' for a nameless decider — and past holders may read while only the current holder may resume.

laws.name: THE DELETE DOOR IS A RESOLUTION DOOR
aliases: WORKFLOW DELETE SETTLES EVERYTHING LIVING ON IT
laws.statement: Deleting a workflow settles every live run, gate ask and standing binding on it before the row dies — a deleted workflow leaves no orphan ask on the deck.

laws.name: THE CAPABILITY MAP IS THE ONE REGISTRY
aliases: ONE REGISTRY, EVERY VERB HAS HANDS
laws.statement: Every verb, component and capability lives in one registry; a verb without a preparation path is a build error; adding a capability touches one row, never the classifier, proposer or assembler.

laws.name: WORKSPACE FEATURE GATING
aliases: ADDING A TOOL = ONE LINE IN THE MAP
laws.statement: One map binds each tool to its workspace feature and every surface (chat, AgentOS, Studio, generate-config) reads it, so a disabled feature cannot drift back through any door.

laws.name: THE MODEL PARAM FLOOR
laws.statement: Model-family parameter rules and provider reasoning budgets are applied once at the transport layer for every call site, so a new model is one defaults row and at most one floor rule.

gates.note: indirect — both tiers 77/77

laws.name: THE SOVEREIGN DOOR
aliases: THE TEAM ARRIVES WITH THE MEMBERSHIP
laws.statement: An email-off workspace never reads mailbox framing, never offers a mailbox verb, and never pays for an interview it cannot use; a share on it is refused spoken; coworkers and the seed kit arrive with the membership.

gates.note: the sovereign floor on share

laws.name: THE TIME-BUDGET FLOOR
laws.statement: A route that does AI work in after() declares a maxDuration, home_brief sub-keys are written through one merge helper (never a whole-blob rewrite), and anticipation claims its key only after the work lands.

gates.note: landed W0.5 (uncommitted): every after()-AI route declares maxDuration

laws.note: pending_migration: the maxDuration source floor, the claim-after-work fix and the ordered-read fix are landed and source-gated; the merge itself calls a jsonb_set RPC from 20260922b_merge_home_brief.sql, which the owner has not yet applied, so a racing whole-blob rewrite is still possible in PROD until that migration lands
laws.broken_by: Sep 22: heavy after() work on routes with no maxDuration (killed at the platform default); profiles.home_brief rewritten whole by five racing writers; anticipation claimed before its work (repair in flight W0.5, uncommitted).

collides_with.precedence: the merge helper is a step toward keyed rows (W2.6), not a second home

laws.name: COMPANY GOALS NEVER REACH COWORKER CONTEXT
aliases: STRATEGY IS A READ-ONLY ADMIN LENS
laws.statement: No worker run context, dependency block or workflow step reads company_goals — employees keep full agency over their coworkers.
laws.fn: source sweep: no company_goals import outside lib/company + admin routes

laws.name: THE AGNOSTIC CLAUSE
aliases: CLIENT WORK IS DATA + OPS, NEVER CODE
A FIX THAT NAMES ONE ACCOUNT IS A REPAIR SCRIPT
laws.statement: Mechanisms derive from the user's own corpus at runtime; client-specific work is data and guarded ops scripts; no real person or client name appears in code, prompts or docs.

gates.note: landed W4.4 (uncommitted): G1 no client-name token in lib/app/components outside a named, reasoned allowlist; G2 lib/tenders/** takes the member folder name and doc-source label as generic-default parameters, never a hard-coded client string (the literal values live in scripts/, the clause's sanctioned ops-script home)

laws.name: THE ANCHOR LAW
laws.statement: A user-stated weekday outranks a model-derived date (user-weekday → date-anchor → untouched); an off-by-one is corrected, never laundered.

collides_with.precedence: domain instance — stated weekday, then anchor, then code's today

laws.name: THE SCHEDULE WINDOW LAWS
aliases: A BLOCK IN PROGRESS AT WINDOW START IS BUSY
laws.statement: All-day rows are exclusive-end calendar days in the event's timezone, a block in progress at window start is busy, and free slots are proportional to the stated window.

laws.name: THE DEPARTURE LAW
aliases: PRUNE ONLY AFTER A COMPLETE FETCH
laws.statement: A sync prunes departed rows only after a complete, paginated fetch scoped to user, connection, provider and window — a partial pull never mass-deletes.

laws.name: THE USER'S CLOCK
laws.statement: The judge reasons at the user's local day and hour from their own calendar; expiry needs a code-verified stated date or time behind that clock, and the weekday is stated by code, never derived.

collides_with.precedence: domain instance

laws.name: THE DATED-SOURCE LAW
aliases: EVERY INGESTION PATH CARRIES ITS DATE
laws.statement: Every fetched page, feed item and search result carries its published date or an explicit UNDATED warning; every AI step has a clock; and a news pipeline ends in a verification gate that keeps the draft's structure.

collides_with.precedence: domain instance for ingested sources

laws.name: THE BRIEFING EDITORIAL LAW
laws.statement: A client briefing workflow observes and never advises, applies its stated market filter at selection and synthesis, removes third-country items unconditionally, and re-earns its editorial gate after every prompt edit — all as workflow configuration, never code.

collides_with.precedence: the law lives in the client's workflow config and patch scripts; the platform holds only the generic gate machinery

laws.name: THE MATCHING EVIDENCE LAW
laws.statement: A match must quote the profile's own text (code-checked), a self-refuting rationale is not a claim, ties break deterministically never alphabetically, user criteria steer but cannot override the evidence law, and the report always states concentration.

laws.name: ONE STRUCTURED TENDER READER
laws.statement: One reader serves both consumers with a code-side day window, folds amendments by procedure, keeps value-unknown rows flagged rather than dropped, and retries transport once.

laws.name: THE SUM LAW + THE RENAME HEAL
laws.statement: Every kind tab equals loose plus the sum of folders on live accounts; renaming a folder re-points every workflow step and manifest atomically with rollback, by exact name only.
laws.fn: kind predicate ladder · rename re-point set

laws.name: THE FOLDER NAME LADDER
aliases: GUESS WITHIN ONE FOLDER'S SPELLINGS, NEVER BETWEEN FOLDERS
laws.statement: A folder name resolves exact → normalized → significant-token subset; a unique candidate wins and a tie errors naming the contenders.

laws.name: THE SEED KIT IS IDEMPOTENT
laws.statement: Seeding clones through the real indexer with content-hash skip so re-apply costs nothing; a stuck row (text, zero chunks) is healed; workspace settings are merge-written, never clobbered.

laws.name: RECORDING SURVIVABILITY
aliases: A RECORDING SURVIVES ITS TAB AND ITS SERVER
laws.statement: Every chunk mirrors to IndexedDB, the session is deleted only after the server confirms, a failed upload is retryable or downloadable but never silently discarded, and a stuck transcription is requeued.

laws.name: THE USER-CONTEXT LANE
aliases: STATED FACTS LAND AT USER SCOPE
laws.statement: Facts the user states about themself land merge-only in user-level memory, never only in the interviewing coworker's private memory, and never touch a conversation on failure.

collides_with.precedence: the lane is the user-scope rung of the memory ladder (W2.4)

laws.name: THE ANSWER SURVIVES THE TAB
laws.statement: The Home-ask answer is persisted server-side before the stream's done frame under a shape-validated room key; the client never double-writes.

laws.name: NEVER HEAD-TRUNCATE A PIPELINE CONTEXT
aliases: THE LAST STEPS ARE THE MOST LOAD-BEARING
laws.statement: A pipeline context is middle-cut so the freshest step and the draft always survive; head truncation silently erases the steps that matter.

collides_with.precedence: a middle cut is still a clip — it declares itself

laws.name: THE MEMORY LADDER API
laws.statement: Every stated fact writes through fileFact(fact, {scope}), which routes it to its one scope — project (via recognition), user (intake-memory merge), or coworker-method — instead of a caller picking its own home; extractAgentMemory routes through it; worker_instructions splits into method + feedback[] so a standing task's feedback tail can never truncate its own method.

gates.note: landed W2.4 (uncommitted): normalizeFact/cleanFact/routeFactScope, capMemoryKeepHead/splitMemoryHeadTail/mergeMemoryLines/uniqCap against MEMORY_TEXT_MAX/MEMORY_HEAD_KEEP; parseWorkerInstructions/renderWorkerInstructions/addStandingFeedback/foldFeedback against FEEDBACK_MAX_ENTRIES/FEEDBACK_MAX_AGE_DAYS; --live adds a read-only census of memory_text rows that look like client facts and standing workflows at the old 4000-char tail cap

collides_with.precedence: the ladder is the implementing API; the invariant is the fact-uniqueness law it must satisfy

laws.name: THE ONE SIG
laws.statement: Every AI cache key is sigOf({version, deps}) or at minimum carries its prompt/law's *_VERSION; the judge's sig includes the evidence set and the entity's own sig; one versions registry re-exports every *_VERSION constant declared in lib/, so no cache can silently key on a stale, unbumped constant.

gates.note: landed W2.5 (uncommitted): S1 sigOf is canonical over key/Set/array order and null/undefined/'' distinctness; S2 every const X_VERSION in lib/ is re-exported from lib/core/versions.ts (allowlist w/ reason); S3 every item_plans cache write carries a sig or references a *_VERSION (allowlist w/ reason); S4 non-item_plans AI caches reference their version in-file; S5 the judge's sig is sigOf-built with the evidence set and the entity's own sig as deps — known out-of-fence caches print, never pass silently

laws.name: THE ONE STORE DOOR (item_plans)
laws.statement: Every item_plans kind is registered once (zod schema for its tasks jsonb, role, what its key means, home module, retention) and read/written through the one typed door; a raw .from('item_plans') outside the door exists only on a shrink-only allowlist, and the retention sweep reads its per-kind table from the registry.

gates.note: landed W2.6 (uncommitted): T1 registry + helpers; T2 the shrink-only raw-site ratchet; T3 no unregistered kind; T4 the hot kinds (judgment, room_brief, pending_change, prep_outcome, workflow_inputs, fulfillment, sweep_claim, sweep markers, prep_requeue, conversation_pair) have zero raw sites; T5 retention read from the registry; T6 schemas accept the live census shapes and refuse wrong ones; D the person_state demolition; V the brief/bundle sigs carry their version

laws.note: raw sites remaining on the allowlist: 151 across 53 files (the non-hot kinds) — each migration shrinks the list

laws.name: AGENTOS PYTHON PARITY
laws.statement: The Python tool schemas and route cases AgentOS serves to its models match the TS registry-derived contract byte-for-byte — a renamed Python arg, a class-A docstring promising an immediate run, a dropped envelope field, a route case with no Python tool, a prompt that drifted from its seed, a legacy role served as an agent, a marker producer with no tool, or a stale NATIVE_ONLY entry each fail the contract rather than drift silently until a live run breaks.

gates.note: landed W4.2 (uncommitted): AP1 the live contract on the real tree; AP2 the AST-lite parser proven on fixtures (multi-line signatures, Optional/defaults, docstrings, module lists, the payload envelope, route cases); AP3 a copy of the tree with one planted drift per class must fail the contract on exactly that drift

laws.name: SOFIA / content_manager PRODUCE DEFAULT
laws.statement: Document production defaulted to the Sofia coworker — retired Aug 14; production is the one production door's job.
laws.note: remaining references are INTENTIONAL render/alias maps (deactivated rows + persisted turns still render the retired role: lib/workers/roles.ts, worker-face, skills-library-view, self-echo RETIRED_ROLE_LOCALS, tool-vocabulary null successor); the stale slack-sofia comment was removed in W2.6

laws.name: TOGETHER AI / private_shared TIER
laws.statement: The third-party OSS host tier — removed Aug 19; the retired-tier guard resolves stray DB values upward.

laws.name: THE MEETING ASSISTANT (AUTO-JOIN BOT) UI
laws.statement: The auto-join bot surface — retired; the Hetzner service stays live only for in-person recording.

Kept: /transcribe + the stuck-transcription sweep + storeTranscriptAndGenerateWork (the in-person pipeline).

laws.name: LABEL-ERA CLUSTERING (normalizeInitiative · THE MAGNET · initiative_state · projects table)
laws.statement: String-label clustering and its tables — superseded by the entity registry. person_state: no writer since July, its last two readers (Home relationship cue, drafter WHO block) removed in W2.6.

laws.name: /work AND /workers SURFACES (team home · review desk)
laws.statement: The standalone team home and review desk — retired into the Home conversation; their UX laws are history.

laws.name: linkedin_post STUDIO TOOL
laws.statement: Deprecated from the picker and generate-config; kept in AVAILABLE_TOOLS for back-compat only.

laws.name: THE AUTONOMY LADDER (autonomous sends behind floors)
laws.statement: Built, proven, and parked the same day by the human-in-the-loop law; the modules survive as design records referenced by nothing.

collides_with.precedence: HITL outranks every autonomy ambition; re-entry needs the owner's word
